new_mechanisms.finding: The prestage is instructed not to invent paths or URLs and to reuse question-specific corpus evidence already present in CONTEXT.world.corpus.
Ordinary corpus lookup excludes zero_luecke and MECHANICAL_GAP_HYPOTHESIS records to stop prior nonknowledge from self-matching as knowledge.
Enrichment is wrapped in ThreadPoolExecutor and Future.result(timeout=2.5) with the stated intent of a hard latency budget.

primary_sources.title: Python 3.13 concurrent.futures documentation
primary_sources.finding: A ThreadPoolExecutor context manager shuts down with wait=True; a running future cannot be cancelled. Therefore leaving the with block after result(timeout) waits for the running task to finish.

primary_sources.title: Assessing Implicit Retrieval Robustness of Large Language Models
primary_sources.finding: Irrelevant retrieved context can substantially harm answer quality, so corpus reuse must include absent, stale and distracting-context controls.

primary_sources.title: RE-RAG: Improving Open-Domain QA Performance and Interpretability with Relevance Estimator
primary_sources.finding: Retrieved passages need usefulness/relevance estimation; mere presence in the retrieved context is not sufficient grounding.

counterevidence.finding: The implementation uses 'with ThreadPoolExecutor'. On TimeoutError, control exits the with block and implicit shutdown waits for the already-running task. A 40.3-second enrichment can therefore still hold the caller for about 40.3 seconds rather than 2.5 seconds.
counterevidence.nonclaim: No live timing receipt was executed in this research pass.

counterevidence.finding: Filtering gap records can prevent echo, but can also hide legitimate queries about known unknowns unless a separate typed route preserves meta-gap observability.
Instructing direct reuse can turn stale or merely lexical corpus hits into quoted claims if relevance, freshness and provenance are not separately admitted.

hypotheses.claim: Enrichment returns control to the caller within 2.5 seconds plus bounded scheduler overhead even when the underlying operation hangs for 40 seconds.
hypotheses.test: Replace corpus_lookup_v2 with an event-controlled 40-second stub; measure monotonic caller latency, active threads, DB connection lifetime and post-timeout writes. Require p99 <= 2.75 seconds and zero late mutation of request-visible state.
hypotheses.falsifier: The caller waits for worker completion, a late worker changes shared state, or repeated timeouts accumulate unbounded threads/connections.

hypotheses.claim: Gap records are excluded from ordinary factual retrieval while remaining accessible through a typed meta-gap/intention endpoint.
hypotheses.test: Paired exact-source queries: factual query matching only a gap record; explicit unknowns query; and real article plus gap record sharing tokens. Bind raw candidates, exclusions, route type, final evidence and answer.
hypotheses.falsifier: A gap record grounds a factual answer, or an explicit unknowns query cannot observe the preserved gap state.

hypotheses.claim: Directly reusing admitted corpus evidence reduces redundant tool rounds without increasing stale or irrelevant grounding.
hypotheses.test: Use held-out present, absent, stale, conflicting and distractor cases. Require exact article-id and snapshot binding, fewer tool rounds, and no loss in independently scored correctness or citation faithfulness.
hypotheses.falsifier: Presence alone causes a stale/distractor snippet to be quoted, or retrieval reuse improves latency while degrading correctness/faithfulness.

counterhypotheses.attack: The surrounding executor context waits on shutdown; result(timeout) only stops waiting at that call site, not the running work.
It may solve one factual-retrieval loop while damaging uncertainty introspection or leaving other derived/self-generated record classes available.
Retrieved material can be irrelevant, stale or conflicting; reuse needs admission, not just availability.

new_concepts.name: Timeout Mirage
new_concepts.definition: A timeout exception is observed, but surrounding cleanup semantics wait for the timed-out work, so caller latency remains unbounded.

new_concepts.name: Late Worker Afterlife
new_concepts.definition: Timed-out work continues using connections or mutable state after its result has been abandoned.

new_concepts.name: Typed Nonknowledge Surface
new_concepts.definition: A dedicated route for inspecting known unknowns without allowing those records to masquerade as factual corpus evidence.

new_concepts.name: Evidence Reuse Admission
new_concepts.definition: A relevance, freshness, provenance and conflict gate applied before already-retrieved text can be quoted as an answer.
